name: ALIGN PRECISION - Tusacloosa (Plant II)
old_description: Aerospace, defense, semiconductor, and evolving high-tech industries require extreme precision in the manufacturing of their parts and assemblies. As your collaborative partner, we align our expertise, technologies, and processes to achieve the tight tolerances required for your demanding applications. Nationwide, our skilled teams have decades of experience working with hard metals, aluminums, alloys, and other exotic materials.
about:
Align Precision operates Plant II in Cottondale, Alabama, serving aerospace, defense, semiconductor, and other high‑technology sectors with precision‑manufactured components and assemblies. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the available data.

The facility provides precision machining, sheet metal fabrication, assembly, and value‑added integration services. It maintains a controlled dust‑free environment rated at no more than 10,000 particles per cubic foot and works with hard metals, aluminum, alloys, and exotic materials for fracture‑critical applications. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Customers include manufacturers in aerospace, defense, and semiconductor industries that require tight tolerances and collaborative engineering support. The company emphasizes its nationwide experience with demanding high‑tech applications.

Align Precision differentiates itself through decades of experience machining exotic materials, NADCAP certification, a focus on tight‑tolerance manufacturing, and a collaborative partnership model that integrates machining, fabrication, and assembly under one roof.
